summary: Ctrl+wheel and Ctrl+plus / Ctrl+minus change the global UI size but nothing persists it, so every restart resets it and a user who needs a bigger UI re-sets it every launch. applyUiZoom in js/utils/uiZoom.js reads the factor live from webFrame and never stores it. Fix is small: persist through js/core/storage.js under a key declared in js/core/storageKeys.js, restore early enough to avoid a resize flash, clamp on read, no-op in Browser Mode where webFrame is null.
